name: Warrior
description: Balanced frontline. Balances damage and control, maintains pressure rhythm.

name: Tank
description: Heavy armor frontline. Absorbs damage to protect allies, disrupts enemy rhythm.

name: Archer
description: Ranged physical DPS. Maintains safe distance for sustained pressure, kites enemies.

name: Mage
description: Ranged magic DPS. Uses control to open combo windows, follows freeze with shatter.

name: Healer
description: Team support. Prioritizes keeping allies alive, uses debuffs and cleanse.

name: Assassin
description: Melee assassin. Uses displacement to flank and dive, executes low-HP targets.
